name: dockula
description: ClaudeDockula: a dock of live panels for Claude Code.

plugins.name: claudedockula
plugins.description: Live panel tabs above the prompt that open docks of panels on the right or at the bottom. Built-in panels: Branch, Checks, Activity and GitGud (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) are on by default; Jira and Slacker are off until you tick them in. Add your own.
